content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online involves creating an online store where digital products can be listed, marketed, and sold directly to customers. For creators in countries where conventional payment platforms are restricted, this can pose a challenge. The good news is that you can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to accept payments in Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. This infrastructure not only provides a way around platform fees but also ensures that you maintain control over your digital assets and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to be resilient and self-sufficient. It combines various free tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. When a customer makes a purchase, they pay in Bitcoin, which is converted to USD at transaction time. This setup allows for automated delivery of products, ensuring that your customers receive their downloads instantly while you retain full ownership of your data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically tailored for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other countries where traditional payment processors fail. Musicians, educators, and content creators who sell music, courses, beats, and digital products will benefit from this architecture. It allows them to bypass the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms, empowering them to reach global audiences while keeping more of their earnings.
Gumroad's 10% fee can significantly cut into your profits; NOWPayments charges only 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A robust digital commerce stack consists of several key components. You need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store, a backend service like Google Apps Script to handle order processing, and a payment processor like NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Each component interacts seamlessly, allowing you to automate the entire sales process from payment to product delivery, all while ensuring that you have complete ownership of your infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, begin by selecting the tools that will form your digital commerce stack. Use Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store and integrate Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Set up NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin. Once your store is configured, upload your digital products, test the payment process, and launch your store. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the blueprints and templates needed for a smooth deployment, including instant download options.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign digital commerce stack. This involves setting up your own online store with tools that allow for crypto payment processing. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments, you can accept Bitcoin and ensure that your earnings aren't diminished by high fees associated with traditional payment processors.
With 100 sales of a $97 product, you can retain an additional $921 by avoiding traditional platform fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're exploring how to establish a digital download store that operates solely on crypto payments, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook by setting up your own online store using free hosting solutions and integrating a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. This method allows you to bypass PayPal and Stripe while still reaching customers globally.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own online store. By using tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you can avoid the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad and Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my music sales?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether. This flexibility allows you to cater to a wider audience while minimizing transaction fees.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

By integrating Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers into your stack, you can automate the delivery of digital products once a payment is confirmed. This ensures customers receive their purchases instantly.
